name: rationsaathi
description: RationSaathi — PDS entitlement & dispute assistant (Next.js PWA + Express API + shared deterministic engine)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && pnpm --filter @repo/api build && pnpm --filter @repo/web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && pnpm --filter @repo/api test && pnpm --filter @repo/web check:i18n
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @repo/shared build && pnpm --filter @repo/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @repo/web exec tsc --noEmit
